meta_description:
184K likes, 1,350 comments - luke_coutinho on September 29, 2026: "Share this with every parent. ❤️

Boy or girl, our children are watching, learning and becoming.

Let’s raise boys who respect boundaries, understand consent, and know that kindness is strength.

And let’s raise girls who know their worth, speak up, set boundaries and never feel they have to shrink themselves to be accepted.

Because raising good human beings isn’t just a parent’s responsibility.
It’s a collective responsibility.

The more we talk about it, the more we teach it, the more we share it… the better the world our children inherit.

Let’s raise them right. Together.

#GirlSafety #WomenSafety #ChildSafety #GirlChild #RaiseBoysRight RaiseGoodHumans Parenting ConsciousParenting ParentingInIndia TeachConsent ConsentEducation Respect RaiseThemRight ChildProtection SaferWorld".
